title: Crop Museum
walkHelp: Walk with WASD/arrows or tap the floor. Tap a case to view or change its exhibit.
arrangeHelp: Select a case to move it, or choose Place case. Keep the red aisle clear.
placingHelp: Tap a valid floor tile. Cancel keeps the original case in place.
invalid: That spot would block the aisle, overlap a case, or close a walkway.
emptyDescription: Choose a donated crop to put on display. Donate crops from the Collection book first.
noDonations: No donated crops yet. Open Collection to make your first donation.
starterHelp: Walk with WASD/arrows. Choose Arrange, then Place case to use your free case.
